activate.description: Bring Photos to the foreground without selecting or editing a photo or video.

activate-direct.description: Foreground Photos without opening a photo or video.

requires_confirmation: AirDrop of exact media may persist it in the Photos library
prohibited: deleting, editing, favoriting, hiding, selecting, sharing, publishing, or creating albums
constructing or guessing iCloud Link, Shared Album, or private asset identifiers
claiming library import or exact media opening from callback or launch acceptance
safety.uncertain_outcome: A launch or transfer may already have occurred. Inspect and do not replay.

data_access: No photo or video contents, recents, collaboration, or account state is read
data_sent: One explicit user-selected local photo or video file through AirDrop when requested
privacy.retention: No file content, path, screenshot, device identifier, or raw response is committed.
privacy.notes: AirDrop may persist received media in the Photos library; opaque sharing tokens are never synthesized.
